product_summary: Designtex International LLP (21/B Pratapaditya Road, 1st Floor, Kolkata-700026, tel +91-33-46013685, info@designtex.in) publishes an article-numbered soft-flooring catalogue only. Confirmed collections on the site: VEGA (188 images, articles VEGA-6028A … VEGA-6237A), AURA (513 images, articles AURA-5456 … AURA-6628), DELTA (20 images, DELTA-5027A … DELTA-5046A), plus a further collection 'Magna' referenced in the post navigation. All items are carpet/rug designs sold by article number with a 'select & send email' enquiry flow — i.e. a textile floor-covering range, not food/FMCG and not plumbing. No valve, tap, faucet, cock or sanitary-fitting item appears anywhere in the catalogue or on the site (sources: https://designtex.in/dtex_gallery/dskec16ppolsrwhr/ , https://designtex.in/dtex_gallery/0wydawbwtl8sgpy8/ , https://designtex.in/dtex_gallery/8jogvkx05u0jlxja/ , sitemap https://www.designtex.in/sitemap.xml).
comment: HS mapping vs. declared codes: 570390 (carpets/floor coverings of other textile materials, tufted) and 570500 (other carpets and textile floor coverings, whether or not made up) are PARTIALLY corroborated — the catalogue is unambiguously a carpet/rug range, but the site never states fibre composition, tufted vs. woven vs. needlefelt construction, or 'made up' status, so the split between 5703 and 5705 cannot be verified from the source. Additional plausible codes for the same range that are absent from the declaration: 570329 (tufted, of nylon/other polyamides), 570242 (woven, of man-made materials), 570210 (Kelem/Schumacks/Karamanie hand-woven rugs). 848180 (taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances) is WRONG / unsupported: no plumbing, valve or sanitary-ware line exists in the published catalogue — this looks like a copy-paste or a second unrelated product line that is not evidenced anywhere on the company's own site. Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground: the company stays in the base, 848180 is dropped from the actual list and the carpet codes are retained. Industry misclassification: the declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is flatly contradicted by the source — the company is a home-textile / soft-flooring (carpet & rug) supplier, so the industry field must be corrected to textiles/floor coverings. Trader signs: the site is a pure catalogue-and-enquiry operation (article numbers, 'select images and send us email', no factory, no plant, no production capacity, no certifications, no address beyond a Kolkata office) — consistent with an agent/stockist/trader rather than a mill; role recorded as trader, not manufacturer. Note also that the corporate WordPress site itself is an unfinished placeholder ('Hello world!', 'Sample Page' — https://www.designtex.in/), so the only real content is the gallery module. Everything above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено': no customs line, invoice or B-L was available in this task, so neither the carpet codes nor the absence of 848180 goods is corroborated by a shipment record — the HS verdict rests solely on the company's own published catalogue. Do not confuse this Indian LLP with the US Designtex (Steelcase, designtex.com), which is a different company selling upholstery/wallcovering.
